title: Apollo 14 blue orb above Mitchell blacked out in LPI scan
summary: Maaneli Derakhshani tells of Apollo 14 blue orb above Mitchell blacked out in LPI scan, about 1971 at Lunar surface, Apollo 14, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there is a blue orb in the lunar sky very clearly. It's very obvious above uh Mitchell.

plain: A researcher, Maaneli Derakhshani, says that in a photo from Apollo 14, the 1971 moon landing mission, a blue orb can be seen very clearly in the lunar sky above the astronaut Edgar Mitchell. He says the orb shows up in one archive of the mission photos but is blacked out in the scan held by the Lunar and Planetary Institute, a research centre that keeps NASA's moon images. If true, it would mean something unexplained was on the moon with the astronauts and that the record was later edited.
